general.title: ECB’s Simkus Says It’s ‘Prudent’ to Hike as Inflation Broadens
general.summary: It’s “prudent” for the European Central Bank to raise interest rates to levels that start to constrain the economy as price pressures broaden beyond oil, Governing Council member Gediminas Simkus said.

Zurrer: Huang’s Credibility in Industry Too Important
general.summary: Jensen Huang is back as head of the world’s most valuable chipmaker, in a stunning reversal less than two weeks after he left Nvidia under a cloud of scandal. This has sent the company’s stock on its biggest rally in decades. Ryan Zurrer, Founder and Director of Dialectic had said a week ago Huang will be making a comeback, and he spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Hong Kong Hedge Fund Tax Breaks Offer Win for Pod Shop Stars
general.summary: Hong Kong plans to link part of its sweeping hedge fund tax breaks to the performance of individual portfolios rather than the overall returns of funds, boosting the city’s appeal to profitable managers at pod shops.

general.title: Australia Bolsters Online Safety Law With Tougher Big Tech Fine
general.summary: The world’s biggest technology providers may face fines of as much as 5% of their global revenue under Australia’s new Digital Duty of Care law after the government toughened penalties to secure its passage.

general.title: Dangote Clears Key Hurdle Toward Africa’s Biggest Listing
general.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE cleared a key hurdle needed for it to start trading on Nigeria’s stock exchange as the nation’s finance watchdog approved how shares in its initial public offering will be distributed among investors.

general.summary: Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. after lobbying by President Donald Trump has revived Asia’s battered AI trade, but investors say it’s done little to resolve the bigger questions hanging over the boom.

general.title: AI Chipmaker Axelera in Talks to Raise Additional $400 Million
general.summary: Axelera AI, a Dutch chipmaker backed by BlackRock Inc. and Samsung Catalyst, is in talks to raise $400 million to expand development of its cutting-edge semiconductors for artificial intelligence, according to people familiar with the matter.

general.summary: Initial demand for Fujitsu Ltd.’s new Monaka server chips is exceeding expectations, fueled by clients seeking alternatives to US and Chinese suppliers, according to the company’s chief technology officer.

general.title: Rajan Warns AI Boom Faces a Reckoning on Returns
general.summary: University of Chicago Booth School of Business Finance Professor Raghuram Rajan says the key question hanging over the artificial intelligence (AI) boom is whether massive investment in compute can generate returns large enough to justify the capital being deployed. He adds that as supply expands, weaker-than-expected demand could create oversupply and put pressure on valuations across the AI ecosystem.
